title: Measurements of CNS-reactive B cells and their specificity in the blood of ocrelizumab-treated patients
summary: The aim of the study is the development of a biomarker for patients with multiple sclerosis who are treated with the drug Ocrevus. We are going to measure the presence of brain-reactive cells in the blood. The presence of such cell should be associated with a better treatment response to Ocrevus.

interventions.name: Measurement of CNS-reactive B cells in the blood of patients with relapsing remitting multiple sclerosis treated with Ocrevus.
